title: "The Chess Player Gazes"
next_chapter_hook: "When the identity of the 49th chess piece was revealed, Chen Ji finally understood—all his schemes were merely wandering on a chessboard drawn by others. In the next instant, those eyes identical to his own would tell him a truth more terrifying than death."

text.content: "Deep within the Tianji Record, the endless Void was like ink spreading across the night. Chen Ji sat cross-legged, the star map around him flowing like a living thing—that was the complete form of the Tianji Record, now being forcibly drawn by a vast will. He felt something in his Mental Sea tearing, as if someone wanted to uproot him entirely and cast him into a boiling cauldron. Cold sweat slid down his temples, but the corner of his mouth curved into a faint smile: Here it comes. The eyes from the end of the last chapter had finally deigned to open and look at him."

dialogue.content:
"『Number Forty-Nine.』

The voice did not come from any direction but resounded directly in the depths of Chen Ji's Mental Sea—ancient, majestic, carrying an suffocating weight of years. Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply: this voice was nearly identical to the residual soul guardian Mo Xiansheng's voice from the first page of the Tianji Record, yet fundamentally different. More ancient. Colder. Like the resonance of countless voices superimposed upon one another."

text.content: "『Did you think you were the one playing the game?』 The voice carried a cold mockery, 『Laughable. You are merely a chess piece this Seat casually placed eons ago—the Forty-Ninth.』 As the words fell, the Void before Chen Ji's eyes twisted violently, countless points of light emerging to form a vast star map. At the map's center, forty-eight points of light slowly rotated around a massive chessboard, while the Forty-Ninth point of light trembled violently at the edge."

dialogue.content: "『The Tianji Record is a tool this Seat granted to the chess pieces. Whether fragmented or not was always part of the design.』 The voice was calm to the point of freezing blood, 『Every time you glimpsed three hours into the future, you took another step under this Seat's gaze. What do you think the Heavenly Fate Value you consumed is? It is the price this Seat granted you for action—and the thread that pulls you toward the end.』 Chen Ji felt a bone-deep chill sweep over him."

text.content: "Chen Ji slowly rose to his feet, though turbulent waves churned in his Mental Sea, his spine remained perfectly straight. Those eyes—identical to the ones that had opened thousands of miles away—now stared into the depths of the Void, as if facing that ultimate chess player directly. 『So,』 his voice was soft yet utterly clear, 『from the very beginning, I was never playing a game.』"

dialogue.content: "『No, you never were.』 For the first time, the voice carried a smile—cold, overlooking all creation, 『However, this Seat must admit, you are more interesting than the other forty-eight chess pieces. You actually tried to use the tool this Seat granted you to turn against this Seat.』 A pause, then the voice continued: 『So this Seat came personally to see—just how high this ant can climb.』"

text.content: "Before the words even finished, a devastating wave of consciousness crashed into Chen Ji's Mental Sea with tremendous force! The Tianji Record's star map shuddered violently, the fragmented pages forcibly unfurled by an invisible force—he intended to force Chen Ji to reveal the complete Tianji Record! Chen Ji felt excruciating pain at his Brow Center, as if an invisible blade were splitting open his skull. He bit down hard on his tongue, blood seeping from the corners of his mouth, hands forming seals, desperately resisting that force."

choice.prompt: "The ultimate chess player's mental attack pressed down like mountains, forcing Chen Ji to reveal the complete Tianji Record—facing this pressure beyond comprehension, he must make a choice:"

choices.text: "Fight with his life, resist with all strength"
choices.description: "Burn his Heavenly Fate Value and Mental Sea origin, clash head-on with that torrent of consciousness—even if his Mental Sea shatters, it does not matter."
choices.visible_cost: "Heavenly Fate Value -30, Mental Sea severely injured"
choices.visible_reward: "Buy crucial breathing time, preventing the opponent from fully seeing through the Tianji Record"
choices.risk_hint: "Extremely high risk: possible immediate unconsciousness or Mental Sea damage"

text.content: "Chen Ji's eyes blazed crimson, and he let out a fierce roar, condensing all his spiritual sense into a single point and slamming it into the core of that consciousness torrent! The two forces collided thunderously within his Mental Sea. He felt as if a thunderclap had exploded in his mind, blood flowing simultaneously from all seven orifices. Yet that torrent of consciousness was actually knocked back for an instant—the Tianji Record's light dimmed, and the force强行展开 was shattered.」

dialogue.content: "『Oh?』 The voice paused slightly, as if carrying a hint of surprise, 『You do have some spirit. But—do you think this can stop this Seat?』"

choices.text: "Go with the flow, let it unfold"
choices.description: "Abandon resistance, let the opponent see all the Tianji Record content—retreat to advance, perhaps discovering weaknesses from it."
choices.visible_cost: "All secrets of the Tianji Record exposed"
choices.visible_reward: "Witness the complete Tianji Record content firsthand, obtain key information revealed by the opponent"
choices.risk_hint: "Medium risk: lose the mystery of the biggest trump card"

text.content: "Chen Ji drew a deep breath, slowly releasing his resistance. His spiritual sense receded like an ebbing tide, allowing that torrent of consciousness to surge straight in. The Tianji Record's pages unfurled completely in the Void—a complex formation map recording countless threads of fate intertwining. And at the map's end, three distinctly different paths were clearly visible, awaiting his choice."

choices.description: "Since the consumption of Heavenly Fate Value is the pulling thread, make that thread a reverse anchor point—borrow force to strike back, corrode a thread of the opponent's consciousness."
choices.visible_reward: "Successfully corroded in reverse, obtained key intelligence about 'Number Forty-Nine'"
choices.risk_hint: "High risk: never attempted by anyone, outcome unknown"

text.content: "A sharp light flashed in Chen Ji's eyes as the Tianji Record method within his Mental Sea suddenly reversed—not to resist, but to actively guide that torrent of consciousness to flow backward along the thread of Heavenly Fate Value! This was his first attempt, but he had already deduced the principle thousands of times: since the opponent monitors him through Heavenly Fate Value, he could reverse-gaze the opponent through Heavenly Fate Value."

"The moment the Tianji Record fully unfurled, Chen Ji saw the true meaning of those three paths—the first path led to supreme Heavenly Fate, becoming a new ultimate chess player; the second path led to oblivion, destruction along with the chessboard; the third path was to have all traces erased, as if one had never existed. 『These are your choices.』 The voice said calmly, 『The three outcome lines were fixed from the moment you obtained the Tianji Record.』"

dialogue.content: "『Interestingly, all forty-eight previous chess pieces chose the first path without exception.』 The voice carried a faint mockery, 『They thought defeating this Seat would make them the new chess player, not knowing that was precisely the outcome this Seat guided them toward. And you—』 The voice paused, as if sizing him up, 『from the very beginning, you have been testing the possibility of the third path.』"

text.content: "Chen Ji's heart shook, but his expression revealed nothing. He stared at the three paths, his mind racing. The opponent had seen through his thoughts yet did not strike directly—what did that mean? 『You won't act,』 he said slowly, voice hoarse but calm, 『because the third path threatens you too? Or because...Number Forty-Nine is itself a variable?』"

dialogue.content:
"Silence.

Endless silence.

Chen Ji felt that torrent of consciousness seemed to ripple slightly, as if some emotion churned within it. Finally, the voice sounded again, and this time, amidst the ice-cold tone was a hint of...amusement? 『No wonder you are this Seat's亲手落下的 chess piece. You guessed half right. Number Forty-Nine is indeed a variable—but not the kind you imagined.』"

choice.prompt: "The ultimate chess player's true intention is shrouded in mystery, the special meaning of Number Forty-Nine gradually surfacing—Chen Ji must inquire:"

choices.description: "Since the opponent is willing to reveal, might as well ask clearly—what does Number Forty-Nine mean?"
choices.visible_cost: "Expose the eagerness to know the answer"
choices.visible_reward: "Obtain more clues about one's own fate"
choices.risk_hint: "May be continue toyed with by the opponent"

dialogue.content:
"『What does Number Forty-Nine mean?』 Chen Ji stared straight into the Void, his voice steady.

The voice fell silent for a moment, then let out a meaningful laugh: 『You think, why would the Tianji Record choose you? A worthless servant disciple of Tianqing Sect,凭什么得到这等逆天之物?』"

choices.description: "Since the opponent is probing him, he must probe the opponent back—point out the opponent's weaknesses, disrupt their rhythm."
choices.visible_reward: "Disrupt the opponent's layout rhythm, obtain crucial breathing space"
choices.risk_hint: "High risk: provoking the ultimate chess player has unpredictable consequences"

dialogue.content: "『You are probing me.』 Chen Ji suddenly laughed, that smile carrying a cold understanding, 『If you truly had complete control over everything, why bother talking here? Just erase me. You won't act—because there is something on Number Forty-Nine that you must personally confirm.』"

"『...』

The star map in the Void trembled violently. When the voice sounded again, it carried genuine interest: 『Interesting. You are smarter than all forty-eight combined. But smart people often die faster.』"

choices.description: "Stop speaking proactively, let the opponent reveal their own weaknesses—sometimes silence has more power than words."
choices.visible_reward: "Observe the opponent's reactions, capture information from subtle changes"
choices.risk_hint: "Low risk: but may fall into a passive situation"

text.content: "Chen Ji closed his mouth, refusing to speak another word. He simply stood there quietly in the Void, the Tianji Record's light wrapping around him, that torrent of consciousness continuously washing over him. Silence. Endless silence. Yet it was precisely this silence that made the owner of that voice impatiently speak first: 『You do have composure.』"

"『You don't want to know why it is forty-nine?』 The voice suddenly continued, as if talking to itself, 『Forty-nine is half the number of Heaven and Earth. The remainder after nine nines return to one. Forty-nine chess pieces correspond to forty-nine fragments of Heavenly Dao—yet the blood flowing in you is precisely the key to activating the final fragment.』"

"Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. Forty-nine fragments of Heavenly Dao? His blood? Countless images flashed through his mind—the rainy night as a child when he was judged to have zero cultivation talent, the broken Jade Pendant his father pressed into his hands on his deathbed, and the soft sigh in his Mental Sea when the Tianji Record first awakened in his hands. So, from the very beginning, he was the chosen key. Not a chess piece—a key."

dialogue.content: "『Now you understand?』 The voice carried a hint of satisfaction, 『The Tianji Record chose you, not because of your talent, your disposition, your strategies—but solely because of your blood. The first forty-eight chess pieces were all meticulously cultivated vessels; and you are the only existence naturally aligned with the Heavenly Dao fragments.』 The voice turned sharply cold, 『This also means—you are the only chess piece that must die.』"

choice.prompt: "The truth exploded like thunder—Chen Ji is not a chess piece but a key, the only existence that must be erased. Facing this lethal truth, he:"

choices.description: "If he truly was a must-die existence, the opponent would have acted long ago—this anger is merely covering fear."
choices.visible_reward: "Completely disrupt the opponent's rhythm, force out more truth"
choices.risk_hint: "Extremely high risk: the opponent may strike directly"

dialogue.content: "『Must die?』 Chen Ji suddenly threw his head back and laughed, that laughter echoing through his Mental Sea with a hint of madness, 『If you truly had the ability to kill me, why bother talking here? Why tell me all this?』 He stepped forward sharply, eyes blazing with brilliant light, 『You cannot kill me—or rather, you cannot kill me personally. Am I right, Eye of Heavenly Dao?』"

choices.text: "Calm analysis, seek a path to survival"
choices.description: "Since he must die, find reasons why he 'cannot die'—every rule has loopholes, including Heavenly Dao."
choices.visible_reward: "Discover a glimmer of hope in the desperate situation"

text.content: "Chen Ji drew a deep breath, forcing himself to calm down. Must die—but why? If he was truly just a key, then he had value to be exploited. Things of value are not easily destroyed. He began rapidly deducing: if the opponent cannot kill him personally, then they can only kill by proxy. And killing by proxy...must have a time gap."

choices.text: "Trace to the source, point directly at the opponent's true form"
choices.description: "Since the opponent can speak within his Mental Sea, trace backward—find the source of this voice, strike at the heart directly."
choices.visible_reward: "Glimpse a corner of the opponent's true form, obtain key intelligence"
choices.risk_hint: "Extremely high risk: may become lost in the Void"

text.content: "A fierce light flashed in Chen Ji's eyes as the Tianji Record method in his Mental Sea abruptly reversed—not to resist, not to exploit, but to directly trace upstream along the source of that voice! He wanted to see, where exactly was this ultimate chess player's true form hidden. In the Void, a crack was forcibly torn open. Chen Ji's consciousness raced through that crack—and then, he saw it."

"In the endless depths of that Void, Chen Ji saw a massive eye. That eye had no pupil, only a chaotic emptiness slowly turning, as if observing all things in the world. The Eye of Heavenly Dao—not any person's eye, but the materialization of Heavenly Dao itself, the embodiment of rules. Chen Ji felt his consciousness nearly crushed to dust beneath that gaze, but at the final moment, he saw a subtle crack at the center of that eye."

dialogue.content:
"『You see it?』 The voice sounded again, this time carrying a hint of dangerous warning, 『You have seen something you should not have seen.』

Chen Ji forcefully recalled his consciousness, stumbling backward several steps. That crack... that was the opponent's weakness! He suppressed the excitement in his heart, yet a knowing smile spread across his face: 『So that is it. You did not want to kill me—you cannot. You are severely injured, and that crack... is the reason.』"

text.content:
"The Void suddenly solidified. That massive eye slowly turned toward Chen Ji, and though it had no pupil, Chen Ji felt a bone-deep chill—rage, the fury of having secrets窥破 by an ant. Yet in the next instant, that pressure receded like an ebbing tide.

『You are very clever.』 The voice sounded again, and this time, amidst the ice-cold tone was a hint of appreciation, 『Clever enough that this Seat must take you seriously.』 A pause, the voice turned sharp: 『But smart people often die from talking too much—this Seat shall see how long you can survive.』"

"As the words fell, that torrent of consciousness abruptly receded. The Tianji Record's light gradually dimmed, and the excruciating pain in his Mental Sea faded away. Chen Ji knelt on one knee, gasping for breath, cold sweat already soaking through his robes. In that instant, he had glimpsed the Eye of Heavenly Dao's true form and seen that crack—the opponent's fatal weakness. But at the same time, he was also acutely aware: the opponent's power far exceeded his imagination. Though that crack existed, the opponent could still easily crush him. Chen Ji slowly rose, gazing into the depths of the Void, a meaningful smile curving his lips. This round, he lost completely—but also gained something. At least he knew his true value, knew the opponent's weakness, and knew... the third path may truly exist."

"He lowered his gaze to his palm, the Tianji Record's patterns flowing faintly beneath his skin. Chess piece Number Forty-Nine? No, he was the key—the key to unlocking that crack. This explained why all his schemes succeeded, why the Tianji Record would choose a worthless servant disciple. His very existence was a threat to the Eye of Heavenly Dao. Now, he finally understood what he needed to do."

"Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes, his consciousness returning to his physical body. When he opened them again, he found himself still sitting cross-legged in the Forbidden Grounds of Tianqing Sect Back Mountain. Stars twinkled overhead, insect chirps drifted from the distance, everything seemed like merely a dream. But he knew this was no dream. The Eye of Heavenly Dao's warning still echoed in his ears, the truth of the three outcome lines had been revealed, and he—Number Forty-Nine—must walk his own path in this ancient chess game spanning countless ages. Above the star map, the Forty-Ninth point of light trembled slightly, as if something was quietly changing."
